note: سوچ is both the noun thought/thinking and the verb stem/imperative 'think!'. 'Content word' is not a POS.
دین means religion/faith. Adjective POS is not needed for the standard learner entry.
سکا is a masculine singular perfect/modal form meaning could/was able to. Noun POS is incorrect.
proposed_english: could; was able to (masculine singular form)

note: ملی is commonly the feminine singular perfect form of ملنا meaning got/received/met, while مِلّی/millī can mean national in a different reading. Noun POS is incorrect.
proposed_english: got; received; met (feminine singular form of ملنا); national (different vocalization/context)

note: برآمد is both a noun meaning export and a participial/adjectival form meaning recovered/retrieved. Adjective-only POS is incomplete.
شکل centrally means shape/form/appearance and also face. The current entry omits shape/form.
دباؤ is the noun pressure/stress/influence and the same spelling can be the imperative 'press!' from دبانا. The current noun/verb POS is plausible but the verb meaning is missing.
رابطہ means contact/connection/link/relation. 'Colon (:)' is spurious dictionary contamination for this Urdu learner entry.
منظور means approved/accepted/granted/sanctioned and is also a common given name. 'Considered; desired' are not appropriate core glosses.
proposed_english: approved; accepted; granted; sanctioned; Manzoor (given name, context-dependent)

note: قبول centrally means acceptance/approval/assent and is used in قبول کرنا 'to accept'. 'Compliance' is secondary and should not lead the entry.
نیچے means below/under/down and functions as a locative adverb/postpositional element. 'Closed-class' is too vague.
محض means merely/only/purely and functions as an adverb/particle. 'Closed-class' is too vague.
روزہ means a fast, especially the Islamic religious fast. 'Daily; starvation; the month of Ramadan' is incorrect/misleading; Ramadan is رمضان.
مریض is both a noun 'patient/sick person' and an adjective 'ill/sick'. Noun-only POS is incomplete.
proposed_english: patient; sick person; ill; sick; ailing

note: گھنٹے is an inflected form of گھنٹہ and must explicitly give hour/hours rather than only inflection labels.
رن is the English loan noun 'run', especially in cricket/sports. 'Content word' is not a POS.
تحریر centrally means writing/text/composition. 'Manumission' is an Arabic-derived specialized sense and is misleading in a general Urdu learner entry.
proposed_english: writing; text; composition; written piece; correspondence

note: سچ is the noun truth and also commonly functions as 'true' in predicative/adjectival use. Noun-only treatment is incomplete.
مسجد means mosque/place of Muslim prayer. 'Synagogue' is incorrect and must be removed.
proposed_english: mosque; Muslim prayer hall/place of prayer

note: بچہ centrally means child/kid/young one. 'Stupid' is not a normal direct meaning and should not lead or appear unqualified.
اعتماد is a noun meaning trust/confidence/reliance/belief. Adverb POS is incorrect.
اپ here represents the English loan 'up' and can function as a loan/prefix element in compounds. 'Content word' is not a POS.
خواجہ is a title/noun meaning master/lord/dignitary and a common honorific/name element. 'Eunuch' is not the direct standalone meaning; that sense belongs to compounds such as خواجہ سرا.
